title: The King Rejoices in Your Strength
summary: The people give thanks that God has granted the king his heart's desire: a crown of gold, long life, glory, and joy in God's presence. Because the king trusts in the LORD and in his loving devotion, he will not be shaken. The second half looks ahead to God's victory over all his enemies, pictured as a consuming fire, and the psalm closes with a call for the LORD to be exalted in his strength.

from.text: Royal psalms are about the king of Israel: his crowning, his wedding, his battles, God's promise to his family (Psalms 2, 18, 20, 21, 45, 72, 89, 101, 110, 132, 144).

from.text: The psalm is a royal thanksgiving

line: Thanks that God has given the king his heart's desire, a look ahead to God's victory over his enemies, and an ending that praises God's strength rather than the king's.
guide: Psalm 20 asked and this one thanks: come back to thank God when the trouble passes, not only before it. Let every success end the way this psalm does, with praise for God.

care.text: Verses 8 to 12 speak of God destroying the king's enemies, even their descendants (verse 10). These are words about the enemies of God's king, spoken to God, and they belong with the hard lines the book page treats in ‘The cursing psalms’. No reading of them makes it right to harm anyone, and no modern nation or army stands in the place of Israel's anointed king.

stanzas.title: Thanksgiving for the gifts God has given the king
The king trusts in the LORD's loving devotion
The coming defeat of every enemy
Be exalted, O LORD, in your strength

verses.t: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
